counting_rule: One completed execution is one recorded scheduled task x arm x repetition. Missing slots, follow-up calls, offline fixtures and categories add no executions. Health is separately accounted and excluded from benchmark totals. Prior historical reports are unchanged and not recounted here.
timing_scope: Selection invocation only: preparation, actual Session wrapper, lazy TLS setup and calls. Imports, credential read, process startup, task execution and skill loading are excluded. Cold Jev resets per observation but reuses transport within follow-up calls; pooled clients reset per repetition. First cold observations retained. Candidate may reuse one bounded Session-owned lexical index; each frame validates the current catalog and each query is searched anew. No decision or disk-index cache.
instrumentation: Durable wire/receipt writes and fsync occur inside every arm timer; this overhead is not subtracted. Hussi selection return latency and worker drain are separate.
hussi_scope: Pinned published chooser, confidence 0.8 and timeout 1.2 seconds. Original uses fresh pinned transport; session control changes transport to pooled HTTPS. Whole-product hooks, fallback models and automatic host activation are not measured.
limits: Synthetic tasks and fixed catalogs; selection latency is not full-agent task speed.

Complete cohorts retain wrong answers and isolated timeout/transport errors in all scheduled timing and quality distributions. Provider-stopped, incomplete and invariant-failed cohorts have no comparative latency or quality claims; completed failures remain counted.
Development CPU overlap is disclosed per study; development timings are not isolated release measurements.
Provider token counts are reported usage, not billing verification or an independently resolved backend revision.
Candidate naming is explicit experiment metadata, not a promotion decision. Native measurement is not joined by this exporter.

Index telemetry validates reported state and lifecycle, not private cache-key equality. Retained bytes estimate retained Python objects; they are not measured process RSS. Missing telemetry remains separate. An empty eligible inventory can return without an API call.
method_notes: These two cohorts contribute 880 planned TypeSafe observations. Earlier reports remain archived separately and are not recounted.
The 676-case offline replay is a separate correctness check and contributes zero additional benchmark observations.
Candidate pooled and cold arms run their normal default Session with one bounded lexical index. No model decisions or disk indexes are cached.
The separately frozen Native supplement contributes 96 observations only after independent audit and an explicit matching-task/catalog/runtime join. It is outside this report.
